title: Faugh a Ballagh
html_source:
Faugh a Ballagh (/ˌfɔːɡ ə ˈbæləx/ fawkh ə bal-əkh; also written Faugh an Beallach) is a battle cry of Irish origin, meaning “clear the way”.
Wikipedia

anchor.prefix: and back. Lots must be killed in storms, telegraph wires. Dreadful life sailors have too. Big brutes of oceangoing steamers floundering along in the dark, lowing out like seacows.
